name: v284_netprofit_level_minus_eps_015
hypothesis: Net-profit estimate yield is strong but overlaps with EPS yield; subtracting a small exact EPS-yield blocker should preserve net-profit-specific information and pass the strict correlation gate.

name: v284_netprofit_level_minus_eps_020

name: v284_netprofit_conf_minus_opquality_015
hypothesis: Net-profit yield plus low dispersion is blocked by an operating-profit/quality active alpha; exact subtraction may leave the analyst-confidence component.
expression: 0.70 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_median / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_high - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_netprofit_low) / abs(enterprise_value), 126), industry) - 0.15 * (0.6 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_profit_before_depr_amort / enterprise_value, 126), industry) + 0.4 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry))

name: v284_netprofit_conf_minus_opquality_020

name: v284_netprofit_revision_minus_eps_opq_020
